name: Tack
description: Top-down sailboat racing for up to ten, where the wind is the track and every sail casts a shadow.

badges.name: Clean Tack
badges.description: Ten clean tacks in one race.

badges.name: Wind Thief
badges.description: Slow three boats with your wind shadow in one race.

badges.name: Photo Finish
badges.description: Win a fleet race by under half a second.

badges.name: Perfect Start
badges.description: Cross the line within half a second of the gun at full speed.

badges.name: No Fouls
badges.description: Finish a racing-rules race without a foul.

badges.name: Gust Rider
badges.description: Sail a whole minute in gusts in one race.

badges.name: Ghost Buster
badges.description: Beat your own ghost in a time trial.

badges.name: Par Excellence
badges.description: A gold medal in a time trial.

controls.action: Press again in the groove to steer past it
Stick steers; Tack and Hike buttons
Left stick steers, A tacks, B or triggers hike

help: Race round the marks and finish first. No boat sails straight into the wind: zigzag upwind with tacks. Steering settles into the groove, the fastest angle. Every sail casts a wind shadow downwind: stay out of theirs, put them in yours. Gusts are dark ripples on the water. Cross the line after the gun, not before. Racing rules: port gives way to starboard.
